q1_issues.issue: "generally" is a frequency adverb in the explicit 0.8 band, so the strength should be 0.8, not the bare-generic 0.9.
The mandatory (QuantifierPhrase wart benign "generally") companion is missing, so the hedged generic is indistinguishable from an unhedged bare one — exactly what the companion exists to prevent.

notes: The slightly downtoner is handled exactly as the Degree rule specifies (positive property kept plus the surface adverb as level), and splitting the coordinated predicate nominal into a definitional genus plus two property atoms is right.
